note: Module 2 E2E, Step 7 (docs/module-2/MODULE_2_E2E_CONTRACT.md; C-02, H-31). Fixed-date national holidays (Japan New Year/Golden Week/Obon, US Independence Day/Thanksgiving/Christmas) are computed programmatically in MarketHolidayCalendar via java.time — this file supplies ONLY the dates that cannot be derived from a fixed calendar rule: Korea's Seollal (Lunar New Year) and Chuseok (harvest festival), which follow the lunisolar calendar and shift every Gregorian year. These dates were entered from training-data knowledge of published lunar-calendar almanacs and have NOT been live-verified against an authoritative source (e.g. KASI, the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute) — verify before relying on them for anything business-critical, and extend this list before requesting a Korean market/year outside the covered range below (an uncovered isoYear simply reports no lunar holiday that year rather than guessing, matching this feature's advisory role in the forecast, not a correctness-critical one).
